questions.prompt: Which ancient Greek was tutor to Alexander the Great?
questions.fact: Alexander reportedly carried an annotated copy of the Iliad from his tutor throughout his campaigns.

questions.prompt: Which theory describes the origin of the universe from a hot dense state?
questions.fact: The name was coined dismissively by an opponent of the idea, and stuck.

questions.prompt: Which sport uses a term called love-forty?
questions.fact: It means the server has lost three straight points, and faces three chances for the opponent to take the game.

questions.prompt: Which film franchise features the character Ellen Ripley's cat?
questions.fact: The cat was used on set to gauge tension, since animals react visibly to sudden movement.

questions.prompt: Which capital city is closest to the equator?
questions.fact: A monument marks the line just outside it, though GPS later showed the marker sits a couple of hundred metres off.

questions.prompt: Which novel is set during the Nigerian Civil War?
questions.fact: The war lasted from 1967 to 1970 and killed an estimated one to three million people, mostly from famine.

questions.prompt: Which company makes a console that works both as a handheld and docked to a television?
questions.fact: It followed the company's worst-selling home console, and became one of the best-selling of all time.
